title: Implementer guide: Chat integration patterns
description: Section on JMAP Chat delegation in practice. Server auto-creating a Chat for each VTCCall. In-call chat message flow (JSON example). Live captions as ephemeral events with senderId attribution (JSON example). In-call reactions via Chat Reaction objects. activeCallId lifecycle (set on active, clear on ended). Lobby chat for waiting participants. JSON examples for each flow.
